subject.title: [Feature]: Add Grok 4.5 to the xAI provider

question: Should OpenClaw add Grok 4.5 as a first-class bundled xAI model now while keeping Grok 4.3 as the setup default for regional safety?
rationale: The code change is likely small, but bundled provider catalogs, alias policy, pricing metadata, and default live lanes are provider/product decisions, and the issue already carries the protected maintainer label.

options.title: Add Grok 4.5, keep 4.3 default
options.body: Publish Grok 4.5 and its official aliases with current metadata while preserving Grok 4.3 as the setup default until regional availability changes.

options.title: Wait for launch clarity
options.body: Hold the catalog update until xAI availability, pricing, and launch docs are stable enough to avoid confusing regional API-key users.

options.title: Rely on explicit overrides
options.body: Do not add a bundled static entry yet, leaving advanced users to select Grok 4.5 through explicit model config or live provider behavior.

recommendation.title: Add Grok 4.5, keep 4.3 default
recommendation.body: Publish Grok 4.5 and its official aliases with current metadata while preserving Grok 4.3 as the setup default until regional availability changes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has direct xAI provider/catalog history.
